top_signals.title: Brooks Steps Up Global Push as Running Boom Builds
top_signals.summary: Brooks Running CEO Dan Sheridan tells Bloomberg This Weekend that a global running boom and consumers’ continued focus on health and wellness are helping drive growth, with the company expanding in markets including Europe and China. Speaking with host Lisa Mateo, Sheridan says Brooks is also expanding its lifestyle business and physical stores while navigating tariffs and supply-chain disruptions without passing all of those costs on to consumers. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: LNG imports make up increasing share of Colombia's natural gas supply
top_signals.summary: Colombia is importing more liquefied natural gas (LNG) as domestic production continues to fall. A potential drought this fall and winter could limit the availability of hydroelectric generation and boost the country's demand for natural gas power generation. Colombia's government has declared a national disaster in anticipation of a drought resulting from an expected strong El Niño.
